spring.headline: Something new is waking up.
spring.lede: Phones down, sleeves up. Come make a tree of your own while the whole valley starts to green.

summer.headline: Long days, slow hands.
summer.lede: Two hours, no notifications, and a little soil under your nails. The tree is the only thing asking for your attention.

fall.headline: Find calm as seasons shift.
fall.lede: Two hours. No notifications. Just you, some soil, and a tree that's going to be yours.

winter.headline: Warm up with something living.
winter.lede: It's cold out. Come inside, set the phone face-down, and put your hands in some soil.
